title: Dragging an object in acre-gui moves it in the source
body:
The render pane in `crates/acre-gui/src/view.rs` pans on any primary drag, and a click sends `goto` for the node under the pointer (`App::go_to_object_at`, `Scene::object_at`).

## Proposal

- A primary drag that starts on an object moves it; a drag that starts on empty canvas pans as now.
- While dragging, the object is outlined and drawn at its offset without rebuilding the scene.
- On release, acre-gui asks the library for the source edits and sends them as an `edit` over the link, or, with no link, writes the edited source to the file, which the file watcher then reloads.
- A refused drag snaps back and the status line shows the reason.
- No new key bindings.
